<!--
Template shipped with the zfbehavior package (inst/skills/behavior-endpoints-bmc/).
Do not edit the analysis code below for a specific study -- put every
study-specific choice in behavior-endpoints-bmc.yml and render with:

  quarto render behavior-endpoints-bmc.qmd --execute-params behavior-endpoints-bmc.yml

This document only calls exported zfbehavior functions (plus Rcurvep's own
plot method on its BMR estimate). See inst/skills/CONVENTIONS.md.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(zfbehavior)
loadNamespace("Rcurvep")  # registers plot() for Rcurvep's BMR estimate

p <- params
skill <- "behavior-endpoints-bmc"

stop_param <- function(msg) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc parameter error: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
}
as_chr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) character(0) else unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
or_default <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
is_unset <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) != 1 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x))) ||
    identical(as.character(x), "CHANGE_ME")
}
num <- function(x, default, what, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf, integer = FALSE) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(or_default(x, default)))
  if (length(v) != 1 || !is.finite(v) || v < lower || v > upper || (integer && v != round(v))) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` must be ", if (integer) "an integer" else "a number",
                      " in [", lower, ", ", upper, "]."))
  }
  v
}

if (is.null(p$run_label) || !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", p$run_label)) {
  stop_param("`run_label` is required (letters, digits, '-', '_').")
}
upstream_runs <- sub("/+$", "", as_chr(p$upstream))
if (length(upstream_runs) == 0) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list one behavior-endpoints run (plus optional intraplate-vc-qc runs).")
}
table_choice <- or_default(p$table, "per_plate")
if (!table_choice %in% c("per_plate", "pooled")) stop_param("`table` must be per_plate or pooled.")
all_types <- c("total_distance", "distance_change_shift", "movement_similarity")
types <- or_default(as_chr(p$endpoint_types), all_types)
if (length(setdiff(types, all_types)) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`endpoint_types` must be among ", paste(all_types, collapse = ", "), "."))
}
types <- intersect(all_types, types)
similarity_metrics <- as_chr(p$similarity_metrics)

# ---- BMR settings per endpoint type --------------------------------------
type_defaults <- list(
  total_distance = list(source = "estimate", rnge = "both", trsh = c(5, 95, 5)),
  distance_change_shift = list(source = "control_mad", rnge = "up", trsh = NULL),
  movement_similarity = list(source = "estimate", rnge = "down", trsh = c(5, 95, 5))
)
rnge_values <- list(up = 1e6, down = -1e6, both = c(-1e6, 1e6))
bmr_cfg <- list()
for (ty in types) {
  cfg <- or_default(p$bmr[[ty]], list())
  what <- function(x) paste0("bmr: ", ty, ": ", x)
  source <- as.character(or_default(cfg$source, type_defaults[[ty]]$source))
  if (!source %in% c("user", "estimate", "control_mad")) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what("source"), "` must be user, estimate or control_mad."))
  }
  rnge <- as.character(or_default(cfg$rnge, type_defaults[[ty]]$rnge))
  if (!rnge %in% names(rnge_values)) stop_param(paste0("`", what("rnge"), "` must be up, down or both."))
  trsh <- if ("trsh" %in% names(cfg)) cfg$trsh else type_defaults[[ty]]$trsh
  if (!is.null(trsh)) {
    trsh <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(trsh)))
    if (length(trsh) != 3 || any(!is.finite(trsh)) || trsh[1] < 0 || trsh[2] <= trsh[1] || trsh[3] <= 0 ||
        length(seq(trsh[1], trsh[2], by = trsh[3])) < 4) {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("trsh"), "` must be null or [from, to, by] giving >= 4 values."))
    }
    trsh <- seq(trsh[1], trsh[2], by = trsh[3])
  }
  out <- list(source = source, rnge = rnge, directions = if (rnge == "both") c("down", "up") else rnge,
              trsh = trsh, bmr = cfg$bmr,
              reason = if (is_unset(cfg$reason)) NULL else as.character(cfg$reason))
  if (source == "control_mad") {
    out$scope <- as.character(or_default(cfg$scope, "global"))
    if (!out$scope %in% c("global", "plate", "chemical")) {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("scope"), "` must be global, plate or chemical."))
    }
    if (out$scope == "plate" && table_choice != "per_plate") {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("scope"), ": plate` needs `table: per_plate`."))
    }
    if (out$scope == "chemical" && table_choice != "pooled") {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("scope"), ": chemical` needs `table: pooled`."))
    }
    pm <- or_default(cfg$plate_medians, FALSE)
    if (length(pm) != 1 || !tolower(as.character(pm)) %in% c("true", "false", "yes", "no")) {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("plate_medians"), "` must be true or false."))
    }
    out$plate_medians <- tolower(as.character(pm)) %in% c("true", "yes")
    if (out$plate_medians && ty != "distance_change_shift") {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("plate_medians"), "` is only for distance_change_shift: ",
                        "the other types are normalized to each plate's own VC median, so every plate median is 0."))
    }
    if (out$plate_medians && out$scope == "plate") {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("plate_medians"), "` cannot be used with scope: plate (one median per plate)."))
    }
    out$n_mad <- num(cfg$n_mad, 3, what("n_mad"), lower = 0)
    if (length(unlist(cfg$bmr)) > 0) {
      stop_param(paste0("`", what("bmr"), "` is not used with source: control_mad; remove it or change the source."))
    }
  }
  bmr_cfg[[ty]] <- out
}

estimate_n_samples <- num(p$estimate_n_samples, 10, "estimate_n_samples", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
estimate_seed <- num(p$estimate_seed, 2022, "estimate_seed", lower = 0, integer = TRUE)
n_samples <- num(p$n_samples, 1000, "n_samples", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
seed <- num(p$seed, 2026, "seed", lower = 0, integer = TRUE)
workers <- num(p$workers, 1, "workers", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
hit_threshold <- num(p$hit_threshold, 0.5, "hit_threshold", lower = 0, upper = 0.99)
chemical_label_cols <- or_default(as_chr(p$chemical_label_cols), "CHEMICAL_NAME")
plate_label_cols <- or_default(as_chr(p$plate_label_cols), "plate_id")
n_col <- num(p$ncol, 4, "ncol", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
pdf_width <- num(p$pdf_width, 15, "pdf_width", lower = 1)
pdf_height_per_row <- num(p$pdf_height_per_row, 2.2, "pdf_height_per_row", lower = 0.5)
panel_order <- or_default(p$panel_order, "alphabetical")
if (!panel_order %in% c("alphabetical", "group_key")) stop_param("`panel_order` must be alphabetical or group_key.")
n_per_page <- num(p$n_per_page, 20, "n_per_page", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
plot_order <- or_default(p$order, "alphabetical")
if (!plot_order %in% c("alphabetical", "as_given")) stop_param("`order` must be alphabetical or as_given.")
chemical_wrap_width <- num(p$chemical_wrap_width, 50, "chemical_wrap_width", lower = 5, integer = TRUE)
activity_pdf_width <- num(p$activity_pdf_width, 17, "activity_pdf_width", lower = 1)
activity_pdf_height <- num(p$activity_pdf_height, 16, "activity_pdf_height", lower = 1)
activity_exclude_endpoints <- as_chr(p$activity_exclude_endpoints)
activity_exclude_reason <- if (is_unset(p$activity_exclude_reason)) NULL else as.character(p$activity_exclude_reason)
if (length(activity_exclude_endpoints) > 0 && is.null(activity_exclude_reason)) {
  stop_param("`activity_exclude_reason` is required when `activity_exclude_endpoints` is not empty.")
}

project_root <- normalizePath(p$project_root, mustWork = TRUE)
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- function(object, ext) {
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(skill, "__", p$run_label, "__", object, ".", ext))
}
# CONVENTIONS.md section 2: every table saved to outputs/ is a tibble,
# including tables one level inside a saved list / result object.
save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  as_tbl <- function(v) if (is.data.frame(v) && !inherits(v, "tbl_df")) tibble::as_tibble(v) else v
  x <- as_tbl(x)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    cls <- class(x)
    x[] <- lapply(x, as_tbl)
    class(x) <- cls
  }
  saveRDS(x, path)
}
md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))
# cairo_pdf renders non-ASCII names and arrows, but on macOS without
# XQuartz it can be reported as available yet write no file: use it only if
# a test file can really be written, otherwise grDevices::pdf.
pdf_device <- local({
  ok <- FALSE
  if (capabilities("cairo")) {
    f <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
    ok <- tryCatch({
      suppressWarnings(grDevices::cairo_pdf(f))
      grDevices::dev.off()
      file.exists(f)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    unlink(f)
  }
  if (ok) grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
})
type_file <- function(ty) gsub("_", "-", ty)

# Saved Curvep runs (bmr-sweep-<type>.rds, curvep-raw-<type>.rds) are kept
# between re-renders and reused when their key (data + settings) is
# unchanged. Everything else from a previous pass is removed.
reusable <- unlist(lapply(all_types, function(ty) {
  c(out_path(paste0("bmr-sweep-", type_file(ty)), "rds"), out_path(paste0("curvep-raw-", type_file(ty)), "rds"))
}))
for (f in list.files(out_dir, pattern = paste0("^", skill, "__", p$run_label, "__"), full.names = TRUE)) {
  if (!f %in% reusable) file.remove(f)
}
load_if_key <- function(path, key) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  obj <- readRDS(path)
  if (identical(obj$key, key)) obj else NULL
}
with_workers <- function(expr) {
  if (workers > 1 && requireNamespace("future", quietly = TRUE)) {
    old_plan <- future::plan(future::multisession, workers = workers)
    on.exit(future::plan(old_plan), add = TRUE)
  }
  expr
}

has_reactable <- requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)
show_table <- function(df, page_size = 15) {
  if (has_reactable) {
    reactable::reactable(df, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
                         defaultPageSize = page_size, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE)
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Run

- Skill: `behavior-endpoints-bmc`
- Run label: **`r p$run_label`**
- Table: **`r table_choice`**; endpoint types: `r paste(types, collapse = ", ")`
- BMR source per type: `r paste(paste0(types, " = ", vapply(bmr_cfg, function(x) x$source, "")), collapse = "; ")`
- BMC: `r n_samples` bootstrap samples, seed `r seed`; hit = hit confidence > `r hit_threshold`
- zfbehavior version: `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior"))`; Rcurvep `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("Rcurvep"))`
- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

## Upstream

Exactly one `complete` `behavior-endpoints` run, plus optional `complete`
`intraplate-vc-qc` runs made on that same endpoints run, whose
`excluded_plates` are dropped (`CONVENTIONS.md`, section 6).

```{r}
#| label: upstream

read_manifest <- function(run) {
  dir <- file.path(project_root, run)
  f <- list.files(file.path(dir, "outputs"), pattern = "__manifest\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) != 1) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: no unique manifest found in ", file.path(dir, "outputs"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  m <- yaml::read_yaml(f)
  if (!identical(m$status, "complete")) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: upstream run `", run, "` has status `", m$status,
         "`, not `complete`. Resolve it first (", m$status_reason, ").", call. = FALSE)
  }
  m$.run <- run
  m$.manifest_file <- f
  m
}
check_md5 <- function(m, pattern, what) {
  outs <- data.frame(path = vapply(m$outputs, `[[`, "", "path"),
                     md5 = vapply(m$outputs, `[[`, "", "md5"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rel <- outs$path[grepl(pattern, outs$path)]
  if (length(rel) != 1) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: upstream manifest of `", m$.run, "` lists no ", what, " output.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  file <- file.path(project_root, m$.run, rel)
  now <- md5(file)
  drift <- !identical(now, outs$md5[outs$path == rel])
  if (drift) {
    warning("Upstream ", what, " md5 differs from its manifest (", m$.run, "): the run was ",
            "modified after it completed. Confirm with the user before using these results.",
            call. = FALSE)
  }
  list(file = file, rel = file.path(m$.run, rel), md5 = now, drift = drift)
}

ups <- lapply(upstream_runs, read_manifest)
up_skills <- vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$skill), "")
if (sum(up_skills == "behavior-endpoints") != 1) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list exactly one behavior-endpoints run.")
}
bad_up <- setdiff(up_skills, c("behavior-endpoints", "intraplate-vc-qc"))
if (length(bad_up) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`upstream` may list only behavior-endpoints and intraplate-vc-qc runs (got ",
                    paste(bad_up, collapse = ", "), ")."))
}
ep <- ups[[which(up_skills == "behavior-endpoints")]]
qc_runs <- ups[up_skills == "intraplate-vc-qc"]
for (m in qc_runs) {
  qc_up <- vapply(m$upstream, function(u) sub("/+$", "", as.character(u$run)), "")
  if (!ep$.run %in% qc_up) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: QC run `", m$.run, "` was made on ",
         paste(qc_up, collapse = ", "), ", not on the endpoints run `", ep$.run, "`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}
ep_up_skills <- vapply(ep$upstream, function(u) as.character(u$skill), "")
imp_run <- sub("/+$", "", as.character(ep$upstream[[which(ep_up_skills == "dataset-import-qc")]]$run))
imp <- read_manifest(imp_run)
endpoints_in <- check_md5(ep, "__endpoints\\.rds$", "endpoints.rds")
combined_in <- check_md5(imp, "__combined\\.rds$", "combined.rds")

up_tbl <- data.frame(
  upstream = c(vapply(ups, `[[`, "", ".run"), imp$.run),
  skill = c(up_skills, imp$skill),
  used_for = c(ifelse(up_skills == "behavior-endpoints", "endpoints fitted", "plate exclusions"),
               "chemical/plate labels only"),
  status = c(vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$status), ""), imp$status),
  # Only intraplate-vc-qc exclusions are applied here; plates excluded before
  # the endpoints run are already absent from its endpoints.
  plates_dropped_here = c(ifelse(up_skills == "intraplate-vc-qc",
                                 as.character(vapply(ups, function(m) length(m$excluded_plates), 1L)), "-"),
                          "-"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(up_tbl, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
  "Upstream runs. endpoints.rds md5 matches its manifest: ", !endpoints_in$drift,
  ". Plates excluded before the endpoints run (already absent): ", length(ep$plates_excluded_by_qc), "."
))
```

```{r}
#| label: load

endpoints <- readRDS(endpoints_in$file)
combined <- readRDS(combined_in$file)

qc_excl <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0), qc_run = character(0))),
  lapply(qc_runs, function(m) {
    if (length(m$excluded_plates) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      plate_id = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$plate_id), ""),
      reason = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$reason), ""),
      qc_run = m$.run, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
))
unknown_excl <- setdiff(qc_excl$plate_id, endpoints$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_excl) > 0) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: QC-excluded plate(s) not in the endpoints: ",
       paste(unknown_excl, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
d <- as.data.frame(endpoints[!endpoints$plate_id %in% qc_excl$plate_id, , drop = FALSE])
d$plate_id <- as.character(d$plate_id)

# Endpoints of the selected types (and similarity metrics).
d <- d[d$endpoint_type %in% types, , drop = FALSE]
run_metrics <- unique(stats::na.omit(d$metric[d$endpoint_type == "movement_similarity"]))
if ("movement_similarity" %in% types) {
  if (length(similarity_metrics) == 0) similarity_metrics <- run_metrics
  missing_metric <- setdiff(similarity_metrics, run_metrics)
  if (length(missing_metric) > 0) {
    stop_param(paste0("similarity metric(s) not in the endpoints run: ", paste(missing_metric, collapse = ", "),
                      " (the run has: ", paste(run_metrics, collapse = ", "), ")."))
  }
  d <- d[d$endpoint_type != "movement_similarity" | d$metric %in% similarity_metrics, , drop = FALSE]
}
missing_types <- setdiff(types, d$endpoint_type)
if (length(missing_types) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("endpoint type(s) not in the endpoints run: ", paste(missing_types, collapse = ", ")))
}
endpoint_info <- unique(d[, c("endpoint", "endpoint_type", "segment", "component", "metric")])
unknown_ex <- setdiff(activity_exclude_endpoints, unique(endpoints$endpoint))
if (length(unknown_ex) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`activity_exclude_endpoints` has endpoint(s) not in the endpoints run: ",
                    paste(unknown_ex, collapse = ", ")))
}
seg_order <- c(names(ep$method$segments), names(ep$method$similarity_segments))

# Labels from the import data (one per plate).
label_cols <- unique(c(chemical_label_cols, plate_label_cols))
missing_cols <- setdiff(label_cols, names(combined))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("label column(s) not in the import data: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
plate_info <- unique(as.data.frame(combined)[combined$plate_id %in% d$plate_id,
                                             unique(c("plate_id", label_cols)), drop = FALSE])
plate_info$plate_id <- as.character(plate_info$plate_id)
if (anyDuplicated(plate_info$plate_id)) stop_param("label columns are not constant within each plate.")
join_cols <- function(df, cols) do.call(paste, c(lapply(cols, function(cc) as.character(df[[cc]])), sep = "@"))
plate_info$chemical_label <- join_cols(plate_info, chemical_label_cols)
plate_info$plate_label <- join_cols(plate_info, plate_label_cols)

# Curve = one plate (per_plate) or one chemical, all its plates (pooled).
if (table_choice == "per_plate") {
  chemical_col <- NULL
  d$curve_id <- d$plate_id
  curve_info <- data.frame(curve_id = plate_info$plate_id, chemical_label = plate_info$chemical_label,
                           plate_label = plate_info$plate_label, n_plates = 1L, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  chemical_col <- as.character(or_default(p$chemical_col,
                                          if (identical(ep$method$layout, "by_chemical_pooled")) ep$method$chemical_col else "DTXSID"))
  if (!chemical_col %in% names(d)) {
    stop_param(paste0("`chemical_col` (", chemical_col, ") is not a column of the endpoint table; ",
                      "use a behavior-endpoints run with layout: by_chemical_pooled (it keeps the chemical columns)."))
  }
  if (anyNA(d[[chemical_col]])) stop_param(paste0("`chemical_col` (", chemical_col, ") has missing values."))
  d$curve_id <- as.character(d[[chemical_col]])
  cp <- unique(d[, c("curve_id", "plate_id")])
  cp$chemical_label <- plate_info$chemical_label[match(cp$plate_id, plate_info$plate_id)]
  curve_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cp, cp$curve_id), function(x) {
    data.frame(curve_id = x$curve_id[1], chemical_label = paste(unique(x$chemical_label), collapse = "; "),
               plate_label = paste0("pooled (", nrow(x), " plate", if (nrow(x) > 1) "s", ")"),
               n_plates = nrow(x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# Curvep input: treated wells; concentration as log10(concentration / 1e6).
curvep_in <- d[!d$is_vehicle_control, c("curve_id", "plate_id", "endpoint", "endpoint_type",
                                        "concentration", "concentration_unit", "endpoint_value_norm")]
names(curvep_in)[names(curvep_in) == "endpoint_value_norm"] <- "resp"
curvep_in <- curvep_in[!is.na(curvep_in$resp), , drop = FALSE]
curvep_in$log_conc <- log10(curvep_in$concentration / 1e6)
if (any(!is.finite(curvep_in$log_conc))) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: non-positive concentration in a treated well.", call. = FALSE)
}
unit_per_curve <- tapply(curvep_in$concentration_unit, curvep_in$curve_id, function(u) length(unique(u)))
if (any(unit_per_curve > 1)) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: curve(s) mixing concentration units (never pooled): ",
       paste(names(unit_per_curve)[unit_per_curve > 1], collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
curve_info$concentration_unit <- curvep_in$concentration_unit[match(curve_info$curve_id, curvep_in$curve_id)]
curve_info <- curve_info[curve_info$curve_id %in% curvep_in$curve_id, , drop = FALSE]

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates_in_endpoints = length(unique(endpoints$plate_id)),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = length(unique(qc_excl$plate_id)),
  plates_used = length(unique(d$plate_id)),
  curves = nrow(curve_info),
  endpoints = nrow(endpoint_info),
  concentration_units = paste(sort(unique(curve_info$concentration_unit)), collapse = ", ")
), caption = paste0("Data fitted (", table_choice, "; value: endpoint_value_norm; log10(concentration / 1e6))."))
if (nrow(qc_excl) > 0) knitr::kable(qc_excl, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Plates excluded by intraplate-vc-qc runs.")
```

## BMR

The BMR is the Curvep baseline threshold (`TRSH`) in normalized-response
units, set per endpoint type and direction (`rnge`). Sources: `user` (given
value), `estimate` (Rcurvep knee-point estimate, reviewed by the user before
use), `control_mad` (median + n_mad x MAD of the vehicle-control values
chosen by `scope`, optionally per-plate medians).

```{r}
#| label: bmr-settings

knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(types, function(ty) {
  x <- bmr_cfg[[ty]]
  data.frame(
    endpoint_type = ty, source = x$source, rnge = x$rnge,
    scope = if (x$source == "control_mad") x$scope else "-",
    plate_medians = if (x$source == "control_mad") x$plate_medians else NA,
    n_mad = if (x$source == "control_mad") x$n_mad else NA,
    estimate_range = if (x$source != "estimate") "-" else if (is.null(x$trsh)) "from the data" else
      paste0(min(x$trsh), "-", max(x$trsh), " by ", diff(x$trsh)[1]),
    reason = or_default(x$reason, "-"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})), row.names = FALSE, caption = "BMR settings per endpoint type.")
```

```{r}
#| label: bmr-estimate
#| results: asis

# Read a user BMR: a number, a map endpoint: number, or (rnge both) a map
# {up: ..., down: ...} of those. Returns one row per endpoint x direction.
read_user_bmr <- function(ty, value) {
  eps <- endpoint_info$endpoint[endpoint_info$endpoint_type == ty]
  dirs <- bmr_cfg[[ty]]$directions
  grid <- expand.grid(endpoint = eps, direction = dirs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  grid$bmr <- NA_real_
  bad <- function(msg) stop_param(paste0("`bmr: ", ty, ": bmr` ", msg))
  set_value <- function(v, rows, where) {
    if (is.null(v)) return(invisible())
    if (is.list(v) || length(v) != 1) bad(paste0(where, "must be a number."))
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    if (!is.finite(v) || v <= 0) bad(paste0(where, "must be a positive number."))
    grid$bmr[rows] <<- v
  }
  fill_endpoints <- function(v, dir_rows, where) {
    if (is.list(v) && !is.null(names(v))) {
      unknown <- setdiff(names(v), eps)
      if (length(unknown) > 0) bad(paste0(where, "has unknown endpoint(s): ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "),
                                          " (endpoints: ", paste(eps, collapse = ", "), ")."))
      for (e in names(v)) set_value(v[[e]], dir_rows & grid$endpoint == e, paste0(where, e, ": "))
    } else {
      set_value(v, dir_rows, where)
    }
  }
  if (is.null(value) || length(unlist(value)) == 0) return(grid)
  if (length(dirs) == 2 && is.list(value) && !is.null(names(value)) && all(names(value) %in% c("up", "down"))) {
    for (dd in names(value)) fill_endpoints(value[[dd]], grid$direction == dd, paste0(dd, ": "))
  } else if (length(dirs) == 2) {
    bad("must be a map {up: ..., down: ...} for rnge: both.")
  } else {
    fill_endpoints(value, rep(TRUE, nrow(grid)), "")
  }
  grid
}

bmr_rows <- list()
estimates <- list()
sweep_status <- list()
pending <- character(0)
for (ty in types) {
  x <- bmr_cfg[[ty]]
  ty_data <- curvep_in[curvep_in$endpoint_type == ty, , drop = FALSE]
  if (x$source == "control_mad") {
    vc <- d[d$endpoint_type == ty, , drop = FALSE]
    group_cols <- switch(x$scope, global = "endpoint", plate = c("endpoint", "curve_id"),
                         chemical = c("endpoint", "curve_id"))
    b <- as.data.frame(estimate_bmr_from_control(
      vc, group_cols = group_cols, value_col = "endpoint_value_norm",
      plate_col = if (x$plate_medians) "plate_id" else NULL, n_mad = x$n_mad
    ))
    b <- merge(b, data.frame(direction = x$directions, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), by = NULL)
    if (any(b$bmr <= 0)) {
      stop("behavior-endpoints-bmc: control_mad gives a BMR <= 0 for ", ty, " (",
           paste(unique(b$endpoint[b$bmr <= 0]), collapse = ", "), "); choose another source.", call. = FALSE)
    }
  } else {
    b <- read_user_bmr(ty, x$bmr)
    if (any(!is.na(b$bmr)) && is.null(x$reason)) {
      stop_param(paste0("`bmr: ", ty, ": reason` is required with `bmr` (why this BMR)."))
    }
    if (x$source == "user" && anyNA(b$bmr)) {
      stop_param(paste0("`bmr: ", ty, ": bmr` is missing for: ",
                        paste(paste0(b$endpoint, " (", b$direction, ")")[is.na(b$bmr)], collapse = ", "),
                        " (source: user)."))
    }
    if (x$source == "estimate") {
      key <- list(data = rlang::hash(ty_data[, c("curve_id", "endpoint", "log_conc", "resp")]),
                  rnge = rnge_values[[x$rnge]], trsh = x$trsh,
                  n_samples = estimate_n_samples, seed = estimate_seed)
      f <- out_path(paste0("bmr-sweep-", type_file(ty)), "rds")
      saved <- load_if_key(f, key)
      if (!is.null(saved)) {
        est <- saved$est
        sweep_status[[ty]] <- "reused"
      } else {
        est <- with_workers(suppressWarnings(estimate_bmr_curvep(
          ty_data, conc_col = "log_conc", rnge = rnge_values[[x$rnge]], n_samples = estimate_n_samples,
          chemical_col = "curve_id", value_col = "resp", trsh_seq = x$trsh, seed = estimate_seed
        )))
        sweep_status[[ty]] <- "computed"
        save_rds(list(key = key, est = est), f)
      }
      estimates[[ty]] <- est
      if (all(is.na(b$bmr))) {
        pending <- c(pending, ty)
      } else if (anyNA(b$bmr)) {
        stop_param(paste0("`bmr: ", ty, ": bmr` is missing for: ",
                          paste(paste0(b$endpoint, " (", b$direction, ")")[is.na(b$bmr)], collapse = ", "),
                          " (give every endpoint and direction, or none to review the estimate first)."))
      }
    }
  }
  b$endpoint_type <- ty
  b$source <- x$source
  b$scope <- if (x$source == "control_mad") x$scope else NA_character_
  b$plate_medians <- if (x$source == "control_mad") x$plate_medians else NA
  b$n_mad <- if (x$source == "control_mad") x$n_mad else NA_real_
  b$reason <- or_default(x$reason, NA_character_)
  bmr_rows[[ty]] <- b
}

for (ty in names(estimates)) {
  est <- estimates[[ty]]
  out <- as.data.frame(est$estimate$outcome)
  out$direction <- ifelse(out$RNGE > 0, "up", "down")
  out <- merge(out, as.data.frame(est$trsh_seq), by = "endpoint")
  out <- out[, intersect(c("endpoint", "direction", "bmr_ori", "bmr_exp", "qc", "trsh_from", "trsh_to",
                           "trsh_by", "n_trsh"), names(out))]
  save_rds(est$estimate, out_path(paste0("bmr-estimate-", type_file(ty)), "rds"))
  cat("\n### Knee-point estimate:", ty, "\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(out, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
    "Rcurvep::estimate_dataset_bmr() (", estimate_n_samples, " samples, seed ", estimate_seed,
    "; sweep ", sweep_status[[ty]], "). A suggestion only: the user chooses the BMR.")))
  bmr_plot <- plot(est$estimate)
  n_panels <- nrow(est$estimate$outcome)
  h <- max(5, 2.5 * ceiling(n_panels / 4))
  grDevices::pdf(out_path(paste0("bmr-estimate-", type_file(ty)), "pdf"), width = 12, height = h)
  print(bmr_plot)
  invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
  cat("\nPlot: `", out_path(paste0("bmr-estimate-", type_file(ty)), "pdf"), "`\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (length(pending) > 0) {
  cat("\n**No BMR chosen yet for:", paste(pending, collapse = ", "),
      "** -- review the estimate(s) above, then set `bmr` and `reason` for that type in the yml and",
      "re-render (the saved sweep is reused).\n")
}
```

```{r}
            "scope", "plate_medians", "n_mad", "n_values", "vc_median", "vc_mad", "reason")
  for (cc in setdiff(cols, names(b))) b[[cc]] <- NA
  b[, cols]
}))

               curves = nrow(x), bmr_min = signif(min(x$bmr), 3), bmr_median = signif(stats::median(x$bmr), 3),

  }))
```

## BMC

One Curvep run per endpoint type (`run_bmc_curvep()`, endpoints x
directions x curves), reused when the data, BMRs and settings are
unchanged. BMC = `10^POD * 1e6`, in the curve's concentration unit.

```{r}
#| label: bmc

bmc_status <- list()
results <- NULL
ready <- setdiff(types, pending)
res_list <- list()
for (ty in ready) {
  ty_data <- curvep_in[curvep_in$endpoint_type == ty, , drop = FALSE]
  bt <- bmr_table[bmr_table$endpoint_type == ty, , drop = FALSE]
  keyed <- !all(is.na(bt$curve_id))
  bt_run <- bt[, c("endpoint", if (keyed) "curve_id", "bmr", "RNGE"), drop = FALSE]
  key <- list(data = rlang::hash(ty_data[, c("curve_id", "endpoint", "log_conc", "resp")]),
              bmr = rlang::hash(bt_run), n_samples = n_samples, seed = seed)
  f <- out_path(paste0("curvep-raw-", type_file(ty)), "rds")
  saved <- load_if_key(f, key)
  if (!is.null(saved)) {
    bmc <- saved$bmc
    bmc_status[[ty]] <- "reused"
  } else {
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    bmc <- with_workers(run_bmc_curvep(
      ty_data, bmr_table = bt_run, chemical_col = "curve_id", conc_col = "log_conc",
      value_col = "resp", bmr_key_cols = if (keyed) "curve_id" else NULL,
      n_samples = n_samples, seed = seed
    ))
    bmc_status[[ty]] <- paste0("computed (", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1), " min)")
    save_rds(list(key = key, bmc = bmc), f)
  }
  act <- as.data.frame(bmc$act_summary)
  act[] <- lapply(act, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) unname(v) else v)  # drop "2.5%" names
  names(act)[names(act) == "chemical"] <- "curve_id"
  act$direction <- ifelse(act$RNGE > 0, "up", "down")
  res_list[[ty]] <- act
}

if (length(res_list) > 0) {
  act <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res_list, function(a) a[, Reduce(intersect, lapply(res_list, names))]))
  rownames(act) <- NULL
  results <- merge(curve_info, act, by = "curve_id", sort = FALSE)
  results <- merge(endpoint_info, results, by = "endpoint", sort = FALSE)
  results$hit <- results$hit_confidence > hit_threshold
  results$BMC <- 10^results$POD_med * 1e6
  results$BMCL <- 10^results$POD_cil * 1e6
  results$BMCU <- 10^results$POD_ciu * 1e6
  # One direction per curve x endpoint is plotted: the one with the higher
  # hit confidence (then the lower POD); single-direction types: that one.
  ord <- order(results$curve_id, results$endpoint, -results$hit_confidence, results$POD_med)
  results <- results[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  results$plotted <- !duplicated(results[, c("curve_id", "endpoint")])
  lead <- c("endpoint_type", "endpoint", "direction", "curve_id", "chemical_label", "plate_label", "n_plates",
            "concentration_unit", "TRSH", "RNGE", "hit_confidence", "hit", "plotted", "BMC", "BMCL", "BMCU")
  results <- results[order(match(results$endpoint_type, all_types), match(results$segment, seg_order),
                           results$endpoint, -results$hit_confidence, results$curve_id), ]
  results <- tibble::as_tibble(results[, c(lead, setdiff(names(results), lead))])

  counts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(results, list(results$endpoint, results$direction), drop = TRUE), function(x) {
    data.frame(endpoint_type = x$endpoint_type[1], endpoint = x$endpoint[1], direction = x$direction[1],
               bmr = signif(stats::median(x$TRSH), 4), curves = nrow(x), hits = sum(x$hit),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  counts <- counts[order(match(counts$endpoint_type, all_types),
                         match(endpoint_info$segment[match(counts$endpoint, endpoint_info$endpoint)], seg_order),
                         counts$endpoint, counts$direction), ]
  knitr::kable(counts, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
    "Curves and hits per endpoint and direction (hit = hit_confidence > ", hit_threshold,
    "; bmr = median over curves). Curvep: ",
    paste(paste0(names(bmc_status), " ", unlist(bmc_status)), collapse = "; "), "."))
} else {
  cat("BMC not calculated: no endpoint type has a chosen BMR yet.\n")
}
```

## Dose-response plots with BMC

`plot_behavior_dose_response_pages()`: normalized response per dose group
(vehicle control `VC`), one panel per curve
(`r if (table_choice == "pooled") "chemical, points coloured by plate" else "plate"`),
one row per endpoint; BMC and score labels on hits only. Total distance:
the direction with the higher hit confidence is labelled, with an up/down
arrow.

```{r}
#| label: plots

pdf_info <- data.frame(pdf = character(0), endpoints = integer(0), pages = integer(0))
first_page <- NULL
if (!is.null(results)) {
  plot_base <- d
  plot_base$plot_title <- if (table_choice == "per_plate") {
    paste(curve_info$chemical_label, curve_info$plate_label, sep = " | ")[match(plot_base$curve_id, curve_info$curve_id)]
  } else {
    paste(curve_info$chemical_label, curve_info$curve_id, sep = " | ")[match(plot_base$curve_id, curve_info$curve_id)]
  }
  titles <- unique(plot_base[, c("curve_id", "plot_title")])
  key_levels <- if (panel_order == "alphabetical") {
    titles$curve_id[order(tolower(titles$plot_title), titles$plot_title, method = "radix")]
  } else {
    sort(titles$curve_id)
  }
  plot_base$panel_key <- factor(plot_base$curve_id, levels = key_levels)

  pl <- results[results$plotted, , drop = FALSE]
  bmc_plot <- data.frame(panel_key = pl$curve_id, endpoint = pl$endpoint,
                         BMC = ifelse(pl$hit, pl$BMC, NA_real_), score = pl$hit_confidence,
                         direction = pl$direction, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  seg_names <- names(ep$method$segments)
  groups <- list(
    `total-distance` = list(type = "total_distance", rows = seg_names, y = "total distance (normalized)"),
    `distance-change` = list(type = "distance_change_shift", rows = paste0(seg_names, "@both_auc"),
                             y = "distance change (normalized)"),
    `distance-shift` = list(type = "distance_change_shift",
                            rows = as.vector(rbind(paste0(seg_names, "@down_auc"), paste0(seg_names, "@up_auc"))),
                            y = "distance shift (normalized)"),
    `movement-similarity` = list(type = "movement_similarity",
                                 rows = endpoint_info$endpoint[endpoint_info$endpoint_type == "movement_similarity"],
                                 y = "movement similarity (normalized)")
  )
  for (g in names(groups)) {
    gg <- groups[[g]]
    if (!gg$type %in% ready) next
    dg <- plot_base[plot_base$endpoint %in% gg$rows, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(dg) == 0) next
    two_dir <- length(bmr_cfg[[gg$type]]$directions) == 2
    pages <- plot_behavior_dose_response_pages(
      dg, group_cols = "panel_key", title_col = "plot_title",
      bmc_data = bmc_plot[bmc_plot$endpoint %in% gg$rows, , drop = FALSE],
      direction_col = if (two_dir) "direction" else NULL,
      endpoint_order = gg$rows, point_colour_col = if (table_choice == "pooled") "plate_id" else NULL,
      y_label = gg$y, nrow = 1, ncol = n_col
    )
    height <- 1.5 + pdf_height_per_row * length(unique(dg$endpoint))
    f <- out_path(paste0("dose-response-", g), "pdf")
    dev_fun <- pdf_device
    dev_fun(f, width = pdf_width, height = height, onefile = TRUE)
    for (pg in pages) {
      grid::grid.newpage()
      grid::grid.draw(pg)
    }
    invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
    if (is.null(first_page)) first_page <- list(page = pages[[1]], height = height, pdf = f)
    pdf_info <- rbind(pdf_info, data.frame(pdf = f, endpoints = length(unique(dg$endpoint)), pages = length(pages)))
  }
  knitr::kable(pdf_info, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0("Dose-response PDFs written (",
                                                              length(key_levels), " panels each)."))
}
```

## Activity plot

`plot_behavior_bmc_activity_pages()`, the same layout as the ANOVA activity
plot: chemicals as facet rows (`r plot_order`; `r n_per_page` plate rows
per page), `r if (table_choice == "pooled") "the pooled curve" else "plates"`
as rows within a chemical, columns = endpoint families, x = segments. Point
size = hit-confidence class; only hits are drawn, labelled with the BMC
(total distance: with the direction arrow). Endpoints left out of this plot:
`r if (length(activity_exclude_endpoints) == 0) "none" else paste(activity_exclude_endpoints, collapse = ", ")`.

```{r}
#| label: activity-pdf
#| results: asis

activity <- NULL
n_hits_not_in_activity <- 0L
n_label_overflow <- 0L
n_activity_pages <- 0L
activity_pdf <- out_path("activity", "pdf")
if (!is.null(results)) {
  activity <- results[results$plotted, c("curve_id", "chemical_label", "plate_label", "endpoint", "endpoint_type",
                                         "segment", "component", "metric", "direction", "hit_confidence", "hit",
                                         "BMC", "concentration_unit")]
  two_dir_types <- types[vapply(types, function(ty) length(bmr_cfg[[ty]]$directions) == 2, TRUE)]
  arrow <- ifelse(activity$endpoint_type %in% two_dir_types,
                  ifelse(activity$direction == "up", "\u2191 ", "\u2193 "), "")
  activity$label <- paste0(arrow, signif(activity$BMC, 2), " ", activity$concentration_unit)
  activity$in_activity_pdf <- !activity$endpoint %in% activity_exclude_endpoints
  n_hits_not_in_activity <- sum(activity$hit & !activity$in_activity_pdf)
  if (length(activity_exclude_endpoints) > 0) {
    print(knitr::kable(
      data.frame(endpoint = activity_exclude_endpoints,
                 hits_not_plotted = vapply(activity_exclude_endpoints, function(e)
                   sum(activity$hit & activity$endpoint == e), 1L)),
      row.names = FALSE,
      caption = paste0("Endpoints fitted but left out of the activity PDF (reason: ", activity_exclude_reason,
                       "). Their results stay in bmc-results.rds and the dose-response PDFs.")))
  }
  plot_rows <- activity[activity$in_activity_pdf, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(plot_rows) == 0) stop_param("`activity_exclude_endpoints` leaves nothing to plot.")
  pages <- plot_behavior_bmc_activity_pages(
    plot_rows, chemical_col = "chemical_label", plate_label_col = "plate_label",
    hit_threshold = hit_threshold, label_col = "label", segment_levels = seg_order,
    order = plot_order, n_per_page = n_per_page, page_height = activity_pdf_height,
    chemical_wrap_width = chemical_wrap_width
  )
  label_fit <- attr(pages, "label_fit")
  n_label_overflow <- sum(!label_fit$fits)
  dev_fun <- pdf_device
  dev_fun(activity_pdf, width = activity_pdf_width, height = activity_pdf_height, onefile = TRUE)
  for (pg in pages) {
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(pg)
  }
  invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
  n_activity_pages <- length(pages)
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(pdf = activity_pdf, pages = n_activity_pages,
                                chemicals = length(unique(plot_rows$chemical_label)),
                                plate_rows_per_page = paste(attr(pages, "page_plate_rows"), collapse = ", "),
                                labels_not_fitting = n_label_overflow),
                     caption = "Activity PDF written."))
  if (n_label_overflow > 0) {
    warning(n_label_overflow, " chemical label(s) are taller than their panel at activity_pdf_height = ",
            activity_pdf_height, " in: increase `activity_pdf_height` or `chemical_wrap_width`.", call. = FALSE)
    print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(label_fit[!label_fit$fits, ]), row.names = FALSE,
                       caption = "Chemical labels that do not fit their panel."))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: save

    "BMR estimate done for ", paste(pending, collapse = ", "),
    ". Review it, then set `bmr` and `reason` for that type in the yml and re-render."
  )
} else {
  status <- "complete"
  status_reason <- paste0(length(unique(results$curve_id)), " curve(s), ", nrow(results), " curve x endpoint x ",
                          "direction fits, ", sum(results$hit), " hit(s) (", sum(results$hit & results$plotted),
                          " plotted). Inspect the dose-response and activity PDFs.")
}

outputs <- character(0)
save_rds(tibble::as_tibble(bmr_table), out_path("bmr-table", "rds"))
outputs <- c(outputs, out_path("bmr-table", "rds"))
for (ty in names(estimates)) {
  outputs <- c(outputs, out_path(paste0("bmr-sweep-", type_file(ty)), "rds"),
               out_path(paste0("bmr-estimate-", type_file(ty)), "rds"),
               out_path(paste0("bmr-estimate-", type_file(ty)), "pdf"))
}
if (!is.null(results)) {
  save_rds(results, out_path("bmc-results", "rds"))
  save_rds(tibble::as_tibble(activity), out_path("activity", "rds"))
  outputs <- c(outputs, vapply(ready, function(ty) out_path(paste0("curvep-raw-", type_file(ty)), "rds"), ""),
               out_path("bmc-results", "rds"), pdf_info$pdf, out_path("activity", "rds"), activity_pdf)
}
outputs <- unname(outputs)

manifest <- list(
  skill = skill,
  run_label = p$run_label,
  status = status,
  status_reason = status_reason,
  rendered_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
  zfbehavior_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior")),
  rcurvep_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("Rcurvep")),
  upstream = lapply(ups, function(m) list(
    run = m$.run, skill = m$skill,
    manifest = file.path(m$.run, "outputs", basename(m$.manifest_file)), status = m$status
  )),
  import_run = imp$.run,
  inputs = list(
    list(path = endpoints_in$rel, md5 = endpoints_in$md5, md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !endpoints_in$drift),
    list(path = combined_in$rel, md5 = combined_in$md5, md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !combined_in$drift)
  ),
  outputs = lapply(outputs, function(f) list(path = f, md5 = md5(f))),
  method = list(
    table = table_choice,
    chemical_col = chemical_col,
    value = "endpoint_value_norm",
    conc_transform = "log10(concentration / 1e6); BMC = 10^POD * 1e6 in the curve's unit",
    concentration_units = as.list(sort(unique(curve_info$concentration_unit))),
    endpoint_types = as.list(types),
    similarity_metrics = as.list(similarity_metrics),
    bmr = lapply(bmr_cfg, function(x) x[setdiff(names(x), "directions")]),
    estimate_n_samples = estimate_n_samples, estimate_seed = estimate_seed,
    n_samples = n_samples, seed = seed, hit_threshold = hit_threshold,
    plotted_direction = "higher hit confidence (then lower POD) per curve x endpoint",
    activity_exclude_endpoints = as.list(activity_exclude_endpoints),
    activity_exclude_reason = activity_exclude_reason
  ),
  curvep_runs = list(bmr_sweep = sweep_status, bmc = bmc_status),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = lapply(seq_len(nrow(qc_excl)), function(i) as.list(qc_excl[i, ])),
  summary = list(
    n_plates = length(unique(d$plate_id)),
    n_curves = nrow(curve_info),
    pending_bmr = as.list(pending),
    n_hits = if (is.null(results)) NULL else sum(results$hit),
    hits_per_type = if (is.null(results)) NULL else as.list(tapply(results$hit, results$endpoint_type, sum)),
    n_activity_pages = n_activity_pages,
    n_hits_not_in_activity = n_hits_not_in_activity,
    n_labels_not_fitting = n_label_overflow
  ),
  parameters = p
)
yaml::write_yaml(manifest, out_path("manifest", "yml"))
```
